The '''Secondary Rights-Holders Complex''' was the [[pressure]] in [[A'Lenba]] shared by [[Trigdale Metallurgy]] and [[Vaufthau Processing Industries]]. [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] provided security.
